verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product, and nothing in the evidence shows users launching fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: codebase scans internally fan out 'thousands of AI agents' for one scan task, Ultrareview runs about 30 minutes, and 'Fix with cubic' makes one-off targeted fixes. None of these is a user-orchestrated, long-running, multi-task agent fleet.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days
